neighbours.label: the historical present: a present-tense verb narrating a dated past event or a past trip (the company is founded in 1903, I spend a week), against the same events in the past tense
fire: In 1886 the first car with a petrol engine is patented in Germany.
In 1928 penicillin is discovered by accident in a London laboratory.
On my second visit, I spend three days with a beekeeper in the hills.
In 1955 the first theme park of its kind is opened in California.
In 1912 the great ship is launched and sinks on its first voyage.
A year later, I travel to Lisbon and meet the old printer.
In 1964 the high-speed railway is completed in time for the Olympics.
In 1997 the young author is awarded the prize for her first novel.
